AFWD.justification: Forward morphism transforms the base dimension into its square, advancing the computation toward the constant.

AREV.justification: Contravariant step descends from the normalized horn-torus tilt back to its raw arctan value for verification.

CLINK.justification: Sequential chaining binds the minus and plus operations into one arithmetic body.

ENGAGR.justification: Both exact SIC derivation and approximate QED value held without resolution under different gauges.

EVALF.justification: Negative state where derived constant would contradict measurement, though not triggered.

EVALT.justification: Affirmative state where derived constant matches measured fine structure value.

FFUSE.justification: With no split, no multiplication reconstitutes an input; fusion is absent.

FSPLIT.justification: The domain is linear; no element branches into distinct paths, so co-multiplication is absent.

IFIX.justification: The constant expression is permanently fixed in append-only memory, irreversible.

IMSCRIB.justification: The axis count is self-identical and undergoes no transformation under the surrounding arithmetic.

TANCH.justification: The finalized expression closes the system by containing the constant within an immutable law boundary.

VINIT.justification: Before derivation the fine structure constant is an unbound slot with no arithmetic expression attached.

steps.domain_action: uncomputed fine structure constant exists as free parameter with no numeric binding
read out the SIC dimension as integer base d from the state space
raise the SIC dimension to its square producing d squared
hold the seven commuting kernel axes as invariant count unchanged by arithmetic
chain the subtraction of kernel axes from the squared dimension into a partial sum
compute the horn-torus popcount tilt as arctan of one quarter
normalize the tilt by the A2 evaluator factor four times square root of three
reverse the normalization to recover the raw tilt for cross-check
compose the normalized tilt with the partial sum via addition
affirm the derived expression converges to the empirical fine structure constant
permanently write the constant expression into the physical law ROM registry
seal the derived constant as the closed boundary of the system
